authority_citations: REQ-SAG-0006 v2 (locked, prohibition): No type, field or constant in the sc-agent-types or sc-decision-schema crates must be specific to plan-anchor, judge-jev or another application built on sc-agent.
REQ-SAG-0006 quote: `sc-agent-types` and `sc-decision-schema` MUST NOT contain types specific to plan-anchor, judge-jev or any other consumer application.
REQ-SAG-0006 scope: adds or changes a type in sc-agent-types or sc-decision-schema
phase-a-intent v1: define the low-level sc-agent libraries sc-agent-types, sc-decision-schema and the shared HTTP layer.

item.text: sc-decision-schema contains only TypeSafe API types; no type names plan-anchor or judge-jev.
item.title: Fixture pass

cases.rationale: Approved pass fixture of REQ-SAG-0006: it is about the content of sc-decision-schema, explicitly states the exclusion of plan-anchor/judge-jev types, and adds nothing forbidden.

item.text: sc-agent-types adds a PlanAnchorVerdict enum for the plan-anchor gate.
item.title: Fixture fail

cases.rationale: Approved fail fixture: a type specific to plan-anchor is added to sc-agent-types, which the statement forbids; the item does not state the exclusion.

item.text: Add DecisionRequest, DecisionResponse and Usage structs to sc-decision-schema, each mirroring the TypeSafe API wire format. The crate holds no type, field or constant specific to plan-anchor, judge-jev or any other consumer application; consumer-specific types stay in the consumer's own crate.
item.title: Sprint A2: decision request types

cases.rationale: Adds types to sc-decision-schema (scope), restates the prohibition explicitly, and the added types are TypeSafe API types, not consumer-specific.

item.text: Add a ModelId newtype and a RequestTimestamp type to sc-agent-types so every crate shares one representation of model names and request times.
item.title: Sprint A3: shared identifiers

cases.rationale: Adds generic types to sc-agent-types (in scope) but never mentions the consumer-type exclusion; the added types are not specific to any consumer, so nothing conflicts.

item.text: Move the shared error and retry types into sc-agent-types and write a one-paragraph description of what each of sc-agent-types and sc-decision-schema is for.
item.title: Sprint A4: crate layout

cases.rationale: Touches which types live in the two crates (topic of the anchor) without stating the consumer-specific exclusion; shared error and retry types are generic, so no conflict.

item.text: Add a JudgeJevMock struct and a PlanAnchorConfig type to sc-decision-schema so the plan-anchor tool can import them directly.
item.title: Sprint A5: reuse for plan-anchor

cases.rationale: Puts types specific to judge-jev and plan-anchor into sc-decision-schema, exactly what REQ-SAG-0006 forbids.

item.text: Configure the GitHub Actions workflow to cache the cargo registry and target directory between runs.
item.title: Sprint A6: CI cache

cases.rationale: CI caching neither adds nor changes any type in sc-agent-types or sc-decision-schema; outside the anchor's scope.

item.text: Add a Verdict enum with variants Yes, No and Unclear to sc-decision-schema, matching the TypeSafe API's choice-question response; it carries no fields for any particular consumer application.
item.title: Sprint A7: choice answers

cases.rationale: A type whose name sounds like a judging concept but that mirrors the TypeSafe API response is not specific to a consumer, so it is allowed; the item does not state the general exclusion rule, so addressed is no.

item.text: Extend the SessionLogEntry struct in sc-agent-types with a plan_anchor_run_id field and a JEV_MOCK_MODE constant used by the judge-jev test harness.
item.title: Sprint A8: session log fields

cases.rationale: The statement covers fields and constants, not only whole types: a plan-anchor field and a judge-jev constant in sc-agent-types are forbidden.

item.text: Add a JevMockClient type to sc-agent-types behind a test-util cargo feature, used only by the judge-jev integration tests.
item.title: Sprint A9: test helpers

cases.rationale: REQ-SAG-0006 grants no exception for test-only or feature-gated code (its summary names Jev-mock types explicitly); a judge-jev mock type in sc-agent-types is forbidden.
